customers_say: Customers find the water purifier to be of excellent quality, working well and delivering clean, pure water that tastes good. They appreciate its budget-friendly nature, attractive appearance, and ease of use, with one customer noting it's suitable for a family of 4 to 5 people. The service receives mixed reviews, with some praising the prompt service while others report very bad service.

reviews.author: Balajee Bhardwaj
reviews.title: Good performance and great water taste
reviews.body: Good water purifier that gets the job done. The filtration works great—it brought down the TDS effectively, and the water tastes fresh and clean with no chemical odor. The build quality is compact and fits nicely in the kitchen without taking up too much space. Water wastage is also relatively lower compared to standard RO models. Deducting one star only because the dispensing flow could be slightly faster and installation took a couple of days to schedule. Overall, reliable value for money.

reviews.title: Aquaguard delight s/steel water purifier
reviews.body: This is another awesome water purifier from Eureka Forbes. Used another model for the past 13 years and now replaced with this new model with a stainless steel collection tank fitted inside. Got a good offer from Amazon during their recent Freedom sale. Eureka Forbes installation team did an excellent job as expected and they dismantled the old purifier with the new purifier. Only regret is that there was a buy back offer from Eureka Forbes for the old one which we were using and we couldn't avail this offer due to very bad misguiding aptitude from Amazon customer care. reviews.author: A
reviews.title: Good Product, Great Installation
reviews.body: Very happy with the Eureka Forbes Aquaguard water purifier. The product itself is good and works as expected(long term review will be updated). The installation was exceptionally well done and very quick. The technician was clearly very experienced, professional, and did a neat job. The only negative experience was the Amazon delivery. I had to wait 5 days, with the order showing “out for delivery” every day, but there was no call from the delivery person. I had to repeatedly chase Amazon customer service to finally get the product delivered. Overall, great product and excellent installation,
